episode_id.description: SHA-256 of JSON [batch_id, task_id, condition, repeat].

batch_id.description: Release batch; comparisons must remain within batch.

source_line.description: One-based physical line number in source JSONL.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of complete source file bytes.

source_record_sha256.description: SHA-256 of source line bytes excluding CR/LF.

task_id.description: Original identifier; not proof of identical initial state across batches.

source_split.description: Original variation_split or split; not a new dataset train/test split.

condition.description: Original condition name, without merging version suffixes.

repeat.description: Original repeat index; repeated tasks are not independent tasks.

timestamp_utc.description: Original recorded timestamp, not guaranteed request start.

model.description: Requested model alias; provider backend snapshot is not known.

thinking.description: Recorded request setting, not a claim about hidden model internals.

agent_protocol_version.description: Original protocol label; not a full environment fingerprint.

success.description: Recorded environment outcome; not a model-judged label.

score.description: ScienceWorld final score; null for ALFWorld. Negative scores retained.

input_tokens.description: Cumulative reported prompt tokens across calls.

output_tokens.description: Cumulative reported completion tokens across calls.

total_tokens.description: input_tokens + output_tokens; not context window size or FLOPs.

legacy_latency_ms.description: Source latency_ms; scopes differ by runner version.

runner_ms.description: Original episode runner timer, when saved.

end_to_end_ms.description: Exactly runner_ms; never imputed from latency_ms.

cost_usd.description: Historical estimated episode cost, including failed completed episodes; not an invoice.

llm_calls.description: Recorded model calls; interrupted unsaved attempts may be absent.

tool_calls.description: Recorded tool calls; not always equal to simulator moves.

environment_moves.description: Original simulator move count, when saved.

environment_actions.description: Original agent action count, when saved.

max_steps.description: Legacy budget setting; do not infer split budgets from it.

agent_max_steps.description: Explicit agent budget only when present in source.

environment_max_steps.description: Explicit environment budget only when present in source.

initial_observation_sha256.description: Recorded initial-observation fingerprint; not full hidden environment state.

skills_loaded.description: Ordered original loaded Skill identifiers, not Skill text.

retriever.description: Original retriever identifier; null can mean no retrieval.

skill_library_version.description: Original library version; not reconstructed from current code.

skill_prompt_sha256.description: Original Skill-only prompt hash; not complete model prompt.

termination_reason.description: Original termination label, without inferred failure taxonomy.

trace_event_count.description: Length of saved source trace; trace text is excluded from v1.
